stories.title: Hawaii declares emergency as Hurricane Lowell approaches
new_facts: New storm: Hurricane Lowell approaching Hawaii, prompting a fresh state of emergency declaration.
Lowell's core expected to pass over sparsely populated Niihau, causing major statewide rain Tuesday.
Hurricane Lowell strengthens to Category 3, threatening cyclones and deadly surf Monday night.
NHC issues hurricane warning for western Hawaii's Kauai County as Lowell nears at Category 2.
stories.line: Hawaii declares emergency as Hurricane Lowell approaches, expected to bring major rainfall and threaten western islands.

stories.title: Trump threatens Bombardier ban as Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect
new_facts: A GOP senator publicly pushes back against Trump's proposed Bombardier sales ban.
Canadian tariffs set at up to 50%; Washington signals a new round of US tariffs in response.
Names PM Mark Carney and specifies tariff range of 15%-50% effective 12:01am Tuesday.
Canada's retaliatory tariffs on $27.6B of US goods take effect after midnight Tuesday
stories.line: Trump threatens to ban Bombardier jets; Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect as trade escalation continues.
